fixed_inputs.population: transactions with fewer than 10 earlier transactions of the same customer

bootstrap.unit: customer component, resampled within each dataset

limit: the new-customer fraud patterns are the ones written into the generator for this purpose (the existing archetypes placed in a late joiner's first transactions); the result shows how each rule behaves on those patterns, not that it works on real new-customer fraud

full_history_policy_b.note: rows with at least 10 earlier transactions in these datasets, Policy B, point values only. 'unchanged customers' are the customers the extension does not touch: their transactions are exactly those of the default generator with the same seed, so they are five further data seeds. Descriptive; not part of the pre-registered primary population
